# Numeric Widths

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Typography

Switch between readings with the same character count to isolate how monospacedDigit() stabilizes digit widths and prevents the adjacent unit label from moving.

- Before: Digit widths shift the label
- After: Monospaced digits stay aligned

APIs: `monospacedDigit`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

// iOS 17+. Present WidthsDoExample() in your app.
struct WidthsDoExample: View {
    @State private var phase = 0
    @State private var resetID = 0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            WidthsDoContent(phase: phase)
                .frame(maxWidth: 320, minHeight: 180)
                .id(resetID)
            Button("Run example") { phase += 1 }

            Button("Reset") { phase = 0; resetID += 1 }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

struct WidthsDoContent: View {
    var font: Font = .title
    let phase: Int

    var body: some View {
        // excerpt:start
        HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline) {
            Text(phase.isMultiple(of: 2) ? "11:11" : "00:00")
                .font(font) .monospacedDigit()
            Text("remaining").foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
        // Fixed-width digits do not reserve space for extra characters.
        .fixedSize(horizontal: true, vertical: false)
        // excerpt:end
    }

}
```
